description: Fahrrad Zählung Zählstellen is a dataset listed in Open Data Portal Würzburg, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Stadt Würzburg. In der Stadt Würzburg befinden sich verschiedene Zähleinrichtungen für verschiedene Verkehrsteilnehmer:innen. Eco Visio ist einer der Partner im Bereich Fahrradzählung, die SPG ein anderer. In diesem Datensatz finden Sie die Positionen der Zähleinrichtungen. In einem gesonderten Datensatz die dort gezählten Verkehrsbewegungen. Coverage: Würzburg. The portal files it under TRAN. Its keywords are Cycle. The portal shows 9 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is DL-DE-BY-2.0 (http://dcat-ap.de/def/licenses/dl-by-de/2.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-wuerzburg-de-portal.
